scope: Finite source/AST and ordinary proposed protocol/auth/task/descriptor identity review only. No candidate/HF/SUP2 import, model construction, preflight execution, test, array/media read, F/T/HP/solve or render.
source_closure: 14-module conservative relative-import closure plus pyproject, frozen SUP2 and three study scripts. AST includes function-local imports; __init__.evaluate imports evaluation lazily. Not all declared sources necessarily load.
helper_contract: One original build_native_project and one original write_native_project, no constructor substitution or saved model/state reuse.
Task1.1: square side18 -> circle r9 at same (71,40), explicit short [0,.25,.5] load_only target instruction, four metadata changes; all other task fields preserved. Targets are not executed.

In-memory checks cover four uint8 mask field descriptors, native grid/coordinates/connectivity, actual cell-centre closed-disk selection and subset of original square envelope, passive_void, no shared solid/support/port nodes, full ux/uy and background-top overlap, merged fixed/free sets and port/fixed exclusion.
Edge incidence is reconstructed on selected Q1 cells; actual exposed pairs exclude y40 symmetry cut. No distance/contact algorithm is invoked.

Original writer emits model1.1/27 array fields, byte-exact source geometry snapshot, task/array descriptors, response_evaluated=False. Saved descriptor checks reference live in-memory arrays without redecoding new NPZ.
Only one old geometry NPZ is permitted by extension-set guard. Builder/loader/writer may reread that same payload; no universal file-open hook or exact one-open claim.

First exception stops later model/plot stages; actual partial diagnostics retained, partial seal attempted only while original time/resource checks permit. Successful whole-run seal includes PNG and all actual outputs inside original helper window.
plot_contract: Exactly one memory-resident Project plot; no hf_eval import, saved-state read or second model.
Three panels in actual x1 lower-half coordinates: full source phases/constraints, actual Q1 staircase/cell mesh with dashed analytic semicircle and dotted old-square reference, merged fixed nodes.

Circle top cut excluded from physical edge display; Arc theta180..360 is reference only. Port arrows label reference directions, not forces. No mirrored geometry, deformation, force, pressure or fitted-circle claim.

Attributes match Project/model/region metadata: attached support/entity nodes, background selected nodes, ports nodes/weights/directions, model coordinates/connectivity/solid/fixed DOFs, grid and task workpiece.

resource_contract.acceptance: normal_exit + returncode0 + cleanup_verified + F-CPU-CLEAN1/CPU-CLEAN1 + frozen supervisor SHA + helperpass + original-window full seal + outer deadline
resource_contract.cleanup: Original SUP2 same-instance owned Job proof and fixed five-second cleanup; no extra process-control fallback. Sampled RSS is not an OS hard memory limit.

authorization: Direct human circle-preparation request is linked to exact proposed protocol and baseline; no default installation, test or loading authority.
limits: Static readiness is not an executed pass or geometric compatibility result. Actual circle/body counts remain runtime observations.
Only construction and undeformed input compatibility; no equilibrium, independent HP, pressure, effective grip, release, stability or HF5 qualification.
Pixel readability/overlap cannot be established statically; only the one authorized new PNG may later receive the planned pixel QA.
nonblocking_notes: Launcher retains a historical comment mentioning two LF NPZ inputs; executable helper/protocol strictly declare one old geometry NPZ, so this comment does not alter read scope.
The earlier reviewer description of __init__ eager import was corrected: evaluate() has a lazy function-local import. Conservative closure remains appropriate and protocol states this accurately.
